A compact and advanced multirole fighter, the Vortex is capable of operating vertically from small carriers and remaining undetected thanks to outstanding stealth characteristics. While fast, agile, and stealthy when lightly loaded, these characteristics can suffer when carrying a heavy payload of weapons.
A concealed front line fighting position of an infantry team armed with light machine guns, grenades, and rocket launchers. Capable of ambushing unsuspecting vehicles that enter its field of fire.
A controller that allows up to 6-degrees of freedom: Translate X, Y, Z and rotate X, Y, Z.

A large, carrier capable, twin engine multirole fighter, the Ifrit is equally suited to air superiority and ground attack missions. It features excellent thrust and maneuverability alongside reduced radar signature and powerful sensors. Two internal weapon bays plus two additional side bays for heat-seeking missiles allow the Ifrit to carry a significant internal payload without impacting stealth or top speed.

Designed for a PALA fast vertical lift program in the 2050s, the UH-90 was conceptualized as a medium-sized compound utility helicopter, but has since been fitted with numerous weapon stations allowing it to occupy a gunship role. Featuring a coaxial rigid rotor system and two reversible turbine-electric ducted fans in pusher configuration, the Ibis can rapidly reach high cruising speeds before decelerating to a vertical landing in less than 30 seconds.

While lacking in speed and survivability, the CI-22 possesses remarkable agility and the ability to mount an array of weapon types

Designed for long-range precision strikes against high value targets, this tactical ballistic missile leaves the atmosphere before reentering on a steep trajectory, exceeding Mach 4 on impact. The Piledriver is virtually impossible to intercept without long range missile defenses in the vicinity of the target.

Designed for rapidly delivering vehicles from Annex class assault carriers to landing points, this fast hovercraft can carry up to 80 tons of cargo and is equipped with an IRM-S1 launcher and heavy machine gun for self defense.

Designed to supplement and eventually replace human sentries, the pillbox represents part of a networked perimeter monitoring system. The hardened structure houses a pair of autonomous 12.7mm machine gun turrets.

Featuring a unique 3-post ducted thrust system, this trainer doubles as an affordable attack aircraft with VTOL capability. The Vagrant is highly maneuverable and capable of transonic speeds, while also featuring a radar to allow engagement of air targets at beyond visual range. Although lacking advanced stealth features, the VT-7 continues to serve as the backbone of BDF naval aviation.

The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is a short range air-defence variant, with a potent 20mm rotary cannon and an IRM-S1 launcher.

The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is an anti-armour variant, equipped with a large, long range multiple ATGM launcher. Internal stores of extra missiles reduce seating capacity substantially.

The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is the default variant, an armoured personnel carrier. The increased seating capacity allows it to capture locations faster than other variants.
The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This variant is an infantry fighting vehicle with a 25mm cannon.
The AFV8 Armored Personnel Carrier is a fast troop transport with a roof mounted machine gun to counter low-flying aerial threats and soft ground targets
The AGM-68 is a large, optically guided missile capable of destroying structures and heavily armored vehicles. It follows an unpredictable trajectory to avoid interception.
The ALND-4 (Air Launched Nuclear Deterrent) is a long range subsonic cruise missile carrying a tactical nuclear warhead.
The AT-145 is a short-range anti-tank guided missile designed for knocking out vehicles, emplacements and small buildings.

The Alkyon AB-4 is an advanced supersonic bomber with electronic warfare capabilities, designed to stealthily deliver nuclear or conventional payloads onto high value targets. 4 afterburning engines combined with variable geometry wings provide incredible top speed and enough maneuverability to evade aerial threats. If critically damaged, a crew escape capsule allows for safe ejection at any altitude or airspeed.
The Auger is a bunker busting gravity bomb with a precision guidance kit. It is capable of penetrating hardened structures before its large warhead detonates.

The Brawler is a reliable and rugged platform built to carry large quantities of precision weapons. Advanced propfan engines combine endurance with respectable speed, while redundant control surfaces, isolated engines, and heavy cockpit armor provide excellent survivability. The A-19 is in its element when attacking convoys of vehicles, distributed short-range air defenses, or vessels operating in coastal waters.
The Chicane can be taken down with a Nuke

The Cursor class represents the vanguard of the BDF fleet. This littoral flight deck (LFD) is designed to rapidly deploy light VTOL aircraft from shallow waterways. It employs a small waterplane area twin hull for stability and speed, and mounts a variety of short-range defensive weapons including a laser air defense system.

The EW-25 is a short take-off, vertical landing (STOVL) support aircraft with a variety of powerful electronic warfare systems. Able to triangulate radar positions, jam enemy radar installations, suppress air defences, and even shoot down missiles with a high energy laser, a single Medusa can easily turn the tide of a battle.

The FS-12 Revoker is built for agility above all else, capable of extreme maneuvers at almost any speed. Internal weapon bays help reduce drag, allowing supersonic speeds even at low altitudes and with heavy payloads. While less stealthy than newer fighters, the Revoker remains a cost-effective means of establishing air superiority.

The Hyperion class features a short take-off ramp and arrestor gear on its landing runway, and can accommodate a variety of aircraft types. Defended by two MMR-S3 batteries, one RAM-45 launcher, and two 30mm CIWS turrets, this fleet carrier is capable of countering most aerial threats.

The IRM-S1 is a man-portable air defense system (MANPADS) effective at countering air threats within 5km. An infrared homing seeker allows the missile to lock onto any aerial target with a heat signature.

The LCV25 is a 4x4 all terrain vehicle, offered in AA or AT configurations, combining the agility of a light recon vehicle with the firepower of heavier fighting vehicles. It is air transportable, with 2 units fitting inside the cargo bay of a VL-49 Tarantula.

The SAH-46 Chicane retains a traditional attack helicopter configuation while incorporating upgrades that keep it a formidable presence on the battlefield of the late 21st Century. Cutting edge stealth technology allows the Chicane to conduct pop-up attacks from behind terrain and disappear from radar without a trace.

The Surf Class is an inshore patrol vessel, nominally used for border protection and anti-piracy duties. While it lacks the staying power of larger ships, its speed and complement of vertically launched AGM-48s can make it a credible threat to them. The 30mm main gun has proximity fused shells and provides some amount of self-protection against missile attack.
This 400kg cluster bomb dispenses 8 GS25 submunitions capable of independently finding and targeting hostile units in the vicinity.

This advanced and highly mobile long-range artillery system fires 155mm laser guided shells. Capable of bombarding targets 40km away at a sustained 5 rounds per minute, the HLT Mobile Artillery will frequently relocate to avoid return fire.

This anti-ship cruise missile can be launched from aircraft or vertically by the Dynamo class Destroyer, using sea-skimming technique and supersonic speeds to penetrate the enemy's air defense systems.

This anti-ship cruise missile can be launched from aircraft or vertically by the Dynamo class Destroyer. It uses a low altitude sea-skimming flight profile and supersonic speeds to penetrate enemy air defense systems.

This anti-ship missile has a very low altitude cruise profile with a pop-up terminal attack mode designed to penetrate ship defenses. Can be deployed from aircraft or launched from an Argus Class Frigate.
This armored air defense vehicle combines off-road mobility with 12 short-range IR missiles capable of engaging low-flying aircraft

This compact warship is well equipped for defending coastal areas, armed with a 57mm cannon, 20mm point defense system, and battery of vertically launched RAM-45 missiles. A small landing pad at the stern allows it to serve as a mobile re-arming and refueling point for helicopters.
This formidable anti-air unit incorporates a radar capable of tracking multiple aerial targets at a range of up to 15km, and carries 16 vertical-launch missiles which can be fired in rapid succession

This glide bomb deploys folding wings, giving it an extended range from altitude. Guided by an optical seeker during the terminal phase, the PAB-80LR features a small radar cross-section and no IR signature.

This heavy machine gun mounted on a tripod is low-cost means of defending point targets from light vehicles and low flying helicopters. Its small size and low profile make it difficult to spot from a distance.

This manually aimed static air defense position is a simple and low-cost means of defending point targets from helicopters and other low-flying aircraft. Its small size and low profile make it difficult to spot from a distance.
This modified AGM-48 replaces the missile's usual warhead with a panoramic optical sensor suite capable of detecting enemy targets and registering them as contacts on faction datalink
This self-propelled anti-aircraft gun sports twin 30mm autocannons firing proximity-fused shells, capable of accurately striking fast-moving targets at ranges of over 4000m
This transportable air defense missile launcher capable of engaging aerial targets within 15km. It can be deployed by a utility aircraft and obtains target info from a nearby radar.
This transportable air defense radar unit can track multiple targets at ranges of up to 17km. It can be deployed by a utility aircraft and is able to provide target info to nearby SAM batteries.
This upfit for the AFV8 chassis features a 25mm cannon and anti-armor missile launcher, turning it into a fast infantry fighting vehicle.
Though lightly armed and armored, the LCV45 is a fast vehicle ideal for forward scouting
Upon arrival within 2.5km (1.6mi) of the designated target, this 500kg glide bomb dispenses 12 GS25 submunitions capable of independently finding and targeting hostile units in the vicinity.
